## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install mojotools in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure mojotools package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to mojotools
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/CarloLepelaars/mojotools):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/CarloLepelaars/mojotools.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/CarloLepelaars/mojotools)

``` sh
$ conda install -c CarloLepelaars mojotools
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/mojotools/)

``` sh
$ pip install mojotools
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/CarloLepelaars/mojotools)’s
[pages](https://CarloLepelaars.github.io/mojotools/). Additionally you
can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/CarloLepelaars/mojotools) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/mojotools/) respectively.
